backup.restore_point: PENDING - name the backup set taken immediately before this apply
backup.production_rule: This release removes the only surviving copy of the pre-D-047 ledger. A fresh backup set is mandatory and its id must replace PENDING before apply; applying while it still reads PENDING is a stop condition.

forward_verification.name: no_mcp_era_version_strings_remain
forward_verification.query: select not exists (select 1 from supabase_migrations.schema_migrations where version !~ '^[0-9]{14}$')

forward_verification.name: no_other_ledger_backup_survives
forward_verification.query: select (select count(*) from information_schema.tables where table_schema='supabase_migrations' and table_name like 'schema_migrations_backup%') = 0

rollback.safe_until: irreversible once applied - there is no compensating recreate

steps.name: restore_from_the_named_backup_set
steps.action: The pre-apply backup set named in backup.restore_point is the only recovery path. The row data exists nowhere else once this runs.

compatibility.evidence: Nothing reads schema_migrations_backup_20260908: no migration, function, view or script in the repo references it (grepped 2026-09-10). The Supabase CLI reads only supabase_migrations.schema_migrations. The guarded DO block refuses to proceed unless the live ledger holds at least 84 rows and every version string is filename-shaped, so a damaged ledger cannot lose its backup.

stop_conditions: backup.restore_point still reads PENDING - name the fresh backup set first
the live ledger has fewer than 84 rows, or any version string is not 14 digits - the DO block raises and nothing is removed
any forward verification query returns anything other than its expected value
this is irreversible; do not apply it in the same window as any other change
